cohort: 36 pregnant women living with HIV and their infants exposed to dolutegravir
finding: No increased maternal or infant morbidity was detected in this study of dolutegravir use during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Of the 36 pregnancies, 18 women delivered by cesarean section, three of which were due to HIV RNA > 50 copies/mL.
gest_age: Mostly full term, one delivery at 34 weeks
